strings.种群 + 选择 + 重组/变异的 Darwin 机器——EC 正统主线，本站收录: Population + selection + recombination/mutation, the Darwinian machine — the orthodox line of evolutionary computation. Covers GA, DE, BBO and the EDA/ES branches.

strings.退火、引力、均衡池、正弦余弦、零参数——把物理过程或数学公式当搜索算子，不靠生物: Annealing, gravity, equilibrium pools, sine–cosine, parameter-free — physical processes or mathematical formulas used as search operators, with no biological metaphor.
strings.教学、和声、帝国竞争——把人类的学习、艺术与政治行为当搜索隐喻。: Teaching, harmony, imperial competition — human learning, art and politics used as search metaphors.
strings.免疫系统——SI/EA 之外的生物启发收容位。: The immune system — a slot for bio-inspired methods outside SI/EA.
strings.不靠种群隐喻，靠「邻域结构 + 接受准则」的工程学——禁忌、变邻域、迭代局部搜索: No population metaphor: engineering built on neighbourhood structure plus an acceptance rule — tabu, variable neighbourhood, iterated local search, GRASP.
strings.元启发式 × 数学规划 × 代理模型 × 自动配置——不发明新隐喻，只做组装厂，: Metaheuristics × mathematical programming × surrogate models × auto-configuration — no new metaphors, just assembly; the family with the highest practical value density.
strings.Pareto 支配下的进化计算——NSGA 五代演进与分解式方法的双雄会。: Evolutionary computation under Pareto dominance — five generations of NSGA and the decomposition-based methods.
strings.Quality-Diversity、神经组合优化、LLM 自动算法设计——元启发: Quality-diversity, neural combinatorial optimisation, LLM-driven algorithm design — the new frontier of metaheuristics.
strings.一隐喻一算法的量产线——本站如实收录机制，同时强制挂批评视角，这是全网同类站都没: One metaphor, one algorithm, mass-produced — the mechanisms are listed faithfully and always paired with a critical view.

strings.同一台机器、同一随机实例、同为 200 代的结果。算法是随机的，换种子结果会浮动: Results from the same machine, the same random instance and the same 200 generations. The algorithms are stochastic and results move with the seed — do not read a 1% gap as a conclusion.
strings.口径：城市随机种子 seed=7 · 算法种子 seed=42 · 200 代: Setup: city seed = 7 · algorithm seed = 42 · 200 generations · same random instance · values are the best tour length (lower is better). The benchmark is a uniform random Euclidean TSP — real road networks, clustered or constrained instances behave differently and rankings often flip, so re-run with bench.py yourself. Note: all 45 algorithms are equipped with the memetic 2-opt component (their common footing) — the table compares framework gain, not whose algorithm is cleverer.
strings.「真在优化吗」自查三问（写你自己的算法时也请照做）：① 关掉全部局部搜索，纯算法: A three-question “is it really optimising?” self-check (apply it to your own algorithms too): ① with all local search switched off, does the bare algorithm still beat the initial solution (NN)? ② is the curve from generation 1 to 200 a real descent, or flat? ③ once converged to a local optimum, can perturbation still kick out a new structure? Only if all three pass is the algorithm really learning; if any fails, it is a fake run (the curve falls, but the algorithm gets no credit for it). This is a hard requirement for every algorithm included here.
